$comment: Shrinking allowlist for the direct-dependency pin gate (GH-1039).
Enforced by `bun run deps:pins:check` (packages/prx/scripts/check-dep-pins.ts).
An entry is how a direct dependency that genuinely CANNOT be pinned today
survives the gate. It is a debt marker, not a waiver: the list only shrinks.
- every entry MUST carry a non-empty `reason` — an entry without one fails
the gate, because the reason is the whole point of the escape hatch;
- a STALE entry — one whose dependency is now pinned, removed or renamed —
also fails the gate, so the list cannot rot into a place floats live.
`entries` is empty because at the time of the sweep every direct dependency
in this repo could be pinned to the version the lockfile had already
resolved. That is the goal state, not an oversight — the mechanism is here
so a float that truly cannot be pinned has a reviewable home, and so that
the gate can be adopted without a big-bang.
Entry shape:
{ "manifest": "packages/prx/package.json",
"field": "dependencies",
"name": "@bounded-systems/example",
"reason": "upstream publishes no immutable tag; tracked in GH-xxxx" }
Out of scope by design (never needs an entry): `peerDependencies` (a
compatibility statement to consumers, not a resolution input) and
`overrides`/`resolutions` (those pin TRANSITIVE deps — see GH-1038).
